work.en: Detailed Motion of the Seven Regulators for Xiande 3

translationRepairs: Jin Gaozu ordered Vice Directors Zhao Renqi and Zhang Wenhao of the Astronomy Bureau, Xu Hao of the Ministry of Rites, and astronomical advisers Zhao Yanyi, Du Sheng, and Du Chonggui to compare the new calendar against Xuanming and Chongyuan and judge its merits.

Jin Gaozu ordered Vice Directors Zhao Renqi and Zhang Wenhao of the Astronomy Bureau, Xu Hao of the Autumn Office, and astronomical advisers Zhao Yanyi, Du Sheng, and Du Chonggui to compare the new calendar against Xuanming and Chongyuan and judge its merits.

秋官正 is the Autumn Office director in the astronomy hierarchy, not Ministry of Rites (春官/禮部). The proposed gloss “(Ministry of Justice)” overreads Zhou-ritual justice into a Tang/Five Dynasties astronomical title, so keep Autumn Office without that parenthetical.

Emperor Gaozu of Jin ordered the Vice Directors of the Astronomy Bureau Zhao Renqi and Zhang Wenhao, the Director of the Ministry of Rites Xu Hao, and the astronomical advisers Zhao Yanyi, Du Sheng, and Du Chonggui and others to test the new calendar against the Xuanming and Chongyuan calendars for gains and losses.

Emperor Gaozu of Jin ordered the Vice Directors of the Astronomy Bureau Zhao Renqi and Zhang Wenhao, the Director of the Autumn Office Xu Hao, and the astronomical advisers Zhao Yanyi, Du Sheng, and Du Chonggui and others to test the new calendar against the Xuanming and Chongyuan calendars for gains and losses.
秋官正 denotes Director of the Autumn Office; “Director of the Ministry of Rites” is a false equation with 禮部/春官. The proposed replacement matches the Chinese title.
(Note: Ouyang Shi's History gives the minor fraction as 89, but this text has 96, which is wrong.
(Note: The Ouyang History gives the minor fraction as 89, but this text has 96, which is wrong.
《歐陽史》 is the work title “Ouyang History”; 史 marks the history book, not a personal name Shi. “The Ouyang History” restores the correct referent.
